```{r}

Yield_Curve_clean <- Yield_Curve %>%
  filter(!is.na(T10Y2Y))

library(lubridate)

Yield_Curve_weekly <- Yield_Curve_clean %>%
  mutate(week = floor_date(observation_date, unit = "week")) %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  summarise(T10Y2Y_weekly = mean(T10Y2Y, na.rm = TRUE))

```


```{r}


start_year <- year(min(Yield_Curve_weekly$week))
start_week <- isoweek(min(Yield_Curve_weekly$week))

ts_weekly <- ts(Yield_Curve_weekly$T10Y2Y_weekly,
                frequency = 52,
                start = c(start_year, start_week))

```

```{r}
model_1D <- arima(ts_weekly_zoo, order = c(0,1,1))
summary(model_1D)

tsdiag(model_1D)

forecast_vals_new <- forecast(model_1D, h = 10)

plot(forecast_vals_new)

checkresiduals(model_1D)

# ADF test on model residuals
adf.test(residuals(model_1D))

coef(model_1D)
theta1 <- coef(model_1D)["ma1"]

cat("Fitted ARIMA(0,1,1) equation:\n")
cat("(1 - B)Y_t = (1 + ", round(theta1, 4), "B)a_t\n", sep = "")
cat("Expanded form:\n")
cat("Y_t - Y_{t-1} = a_t + ", round(theta1, 4), "a_{t-1}\n", sep = "")
cat("Equivalent form:\n")
cat("Y_t = Y_{t-1} + a_t + ", round(theta1, 4), "a_{t-1}\n", sep = "")

```
```{r}


res_df <- data.frame(res = residuals(model_1D))

ggplot(res_df, aes(sample = res)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line(color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Q-Q Plot of Residuals")
```

```{r}

# 52-week forecast
fc_1yr <- predict(model_1D, n.ahead = 52)

# Forecasted values and standard errors
pred <- fc_1yr$pred
se   <- fc_1yr$se

# 95% forecast intervals
upper <- pred + 1.96 * se
lower <- pred - 1.96 * se

# Future weekly dates
last_date <- tail(index(ts_weekly_zoo), 1)

future_dates <- seq(from = last_date + 7,
                    by = "7 days",
                    length.out = 52)

# Put forecasts into zoo objects
pred_zoo  <- zoo(pred,  order.by = future_dates)
upper_zoo <- zoo(upper, order.by = future_dates)
lower_zoo <- zoo(lower, order.by = future_dates)
```



```{r}
# Plot
plot(ts_weekly_zoo,
     xlim = c(min(index(ts_weekly_zoo)), max(future_dates)),
     main = "1-Year Forecast for T10Y2Y",
     xlab = "Time",
     ylab = "T10Y2Y")

lines(pred_zoo, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
lines(upper_zoo, col = "red", lty = 2)
lines(lower_zoo, col = "red", lty = 2)

```


```{r}

forecast_table <- data.frame(
  date = future_dates,
  forecast = as.numeric(pred),
  lower_95 = as.numeric(lower),
  upper_95 = as.numeric(upper)
)

head(forecast_table)


```

```{r}

library(forecast)

y <- as.numeric(ts_weekly_zoo)

model_mc <- Arima(y, order = c(0, 1, 1))

h <- 52
nsim <- 10000
set.seed(123)

sim_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = h, ncol = nsim)

for (i in 1:nsim) {
  sim_matrix[, i] <- as.numeric(simulate(model_mc, nsim = h, future = TRUE))
}

prob_inversion <- mean(apply(sim_matrix, 2, function(x) any(x < 0)))

cat("Estimated probability of at least one inversion in the next 52 weeks:",
    round(prob_inversion, 4), "\n")

```

```{r}

pointwise_prob <- sapply(1:h, function(k) {
  mean(sim_matrix[k, ] < 0)
})

plot(pointwise_prob, type = "l",
     main = "Probability of Yield Curve Inversion at Each Week",
     xlab = "Weeks Ahead",
     ylab = "Probability")


pointwise_table <- data.frame(
  week = 1:h,
  prob_inversion = pointwise_prob
)

head(pointwise_table)


```
